outline.title: Ada and the No-Air Planet
outline.logline: Ada meets an eagle who lands in her bathtub ocean and cannot fly, then helps it find a new way to move using her submarine toy.
outline.theme: trying a different way when the first one will not work

characters.name: Ada
characters.description: A six-year-old girl who wants to explore the ocean in her bathtub with her toy submarine.

characters.name: Finn
characters.description: An eagle who wants to live on the new planet but must learn what works when there is no air.

beats.title: Bathtub ocean
beats.summary: Eli lands on a new world and looks around at the still, grey ground.

beats.title: The eagle arrives
beats.summary: He tries to lift off and cannot, and does not understand why.

beats.title: First try to fly
beats.summary: Ada fills the tub and drops in her toy, watching it settle.

beats.title: Second try to fly
beats.summary: Eli watches the toy sink and rise, and something occurs to him.

beats.title: The bathtub experiment
beats.summary: He folds his wings and tries the water, and it holds him up.

beats.title: Finn tries the new way
beats.summary: He paddles the length of the pool while Ada counts out loud.

beats.title: Together on the planet
beats.summary: The two of them race, and Eli wins by the length of a wing.

pages.visual_action: Ada pushes submarine through tub water
Finn flaps hard above water then drops
Finn tries again from edge and sinks lower
Ada pushes submarine under then lets it rise and glide
pages.emotional_shift: Ada decides to show a new way

pages.visual_action: Finn folds wings and lets water hold him
Finn paddles forward like the submarine
pages.emotional_shift: Finn feels the new way working

pages.visual_action: Ada steers beside Finn in slow circles
pages.emotional_shift: Ada feels happy sharing the planet

pages.text: The wind rose over the ridge.
Eli tilted one wing and fell.
The water held him for a moment.
